[[image:Nightmare Vale.jpg|thumb|Nightmare Vale]]

'''Nightmare Vale''' is a wide valley located in southwestern [[Tirisfal Glades]]. While the glades here were once verdant and teeming with forest animals, now the trees have withered and the wildlife has been eaten by hungry [[darkhound]]s and huge [[bat|vampire bat]]s. The [[Scarlet Crusade]] also has an outpost here. [[Ressan the Needler]], a [[rare]] white bat, also appears here.
